results.details: reauthentication additively extends the entitlement API contract
current-session reauthentication requires POST, CSRF and durable encrypted idempotency
the signed session plus client network subject is rate limited
request and response representations are closed
password exists only in the write-only request schema and never in response or event data
identity and current session come only from signed gateway context
the production validity window is exactly five minutes and response derives from the same configured TTL
session and password credential versions are checked under database locks
password-bearing idempotency requests use a keyed digest and never feed the event payload
successful and failed password proofs are separately audited and integration-tested
SessionReauthenticated is an additive identity event
event envelope and payload are closed and identify only the proof method
the event has a deterministic verified identity fixture
